nfrs.description: LC application creation (POST /trade-finance/lc-applications) must complete with a 201 response within 3 seconds at P99 under normal load. Includes same-capability GET /business-customers/{id} call to SVC-005.
nfrs.measurement: SVC-107 distributed tracing — POST /trade-finance/lc-applications response time

nfrs.description: Trade Finance portal (CH-008) and SVC-006 application endpoint must be available 99.5% of the time during business hours (08:00–20:00 UK time, Monday–Friday).
nfrs.regulatory_basis: FCA PS21/3 operational resilience — trade finance LC application is an important business service

nfrs.description: For in-limit LCs (within approved trade finance facility), the automated facility headroom check (same-capability SVC-005 call) must complete within 2 seconds. The applicant should not experience a delay — credit assessment for in-limit LCs is transparent to the user.
Out-of-limit LC credit referrals must receive a credit decision within 2 business days. Customer is notified of the referral immediately; the 2-day clock runs from referral notification.
nfrs.target: 2 business days for out-of-limit credit decision

nfrs.description: SVC-051 must publish EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared) within 30 minutes of receiving EVT-076 for automated screening (no manual review required). The EVT-076 → EVT-077 round-trip via SVC-102 defines the compliance screening SLA.
nfrs.target: EVT-077 published within 30 minutes of EVT-076 receipt for automated-clear cases
nfrs.regulatory_basis: OFSI regulations require sanctions screening to be performed before LC issuance — the SLA ensures the screening gate does not create unacceptable commercial delay while maintaining compliance

nfrs.description: MLRO review for compliance holds must be completed within 2 business days. MLRO must either confirm the block or authorise an override with documented justification.
nfrs.target: MLRO decision within 2 business days of compliance alert

nfrs.description: If SVC-051 is unavailable, SVC-006 must apply a fail-closed policy: no LC is issued without a compliance clearance event. SVC-006 may queue the screening request for up to 4 hours before escalating to Operations for manual resolution.
nfrs.target: Fail-closed — no LC issuance without EVT-077; 4-hour operational queue before escalation

nfrs.description: SWIFT MT700 must be transmitted to advising bank by SVC-010 within 2 hours of EVT-078 (LCIssued) being published during SWIFT operational hours (07:00–17:00 UK time). For applications submitted after 15:00 UK time, same-day transmission is best-efforts; next business day by 10:00 is the guaranteed SLA.
nfrs.target: MT700 transmitted within 2 hours of EVT-078 during SWIFT hours

nfrs.description: EVT-078 (LCIssued) must be stored durably in SVC-102 with at-least-once delivery guarantee. SVC-010 must implement deduplication on lc_id + issue_date to prevent duplicate SWIFT MT700 transmissions.
nfrs.target: At-least-once delivery with deduplication; no duplicate MT700 transmissions

nfrs.description: CRITICAL REGULATORY SLA: Document examination must be completed and EVT-080 published within 5 banking days of document presentation (UCP 600 Article 14(b)). This is a hard legal deadline — failure to act within this period precludes the bank from claiming discrepancies (UCP 600 Article 16(f)).
nfrs.target: 5 banking days from presentation_date — HARD LEGAL DEADLINE under UCP 600 Article 14(b)
nfrs.regulatory_basis: UCP 600 Article 14(b) — maximum examination period. UCP 600 Article 16(f) — forfeiture of right to refuse on deadline miss.
nfrs.breach_consequence: Bank loses right to claim discrepancies on documents presented under UCP 600 Article 16(f). Bank obliged to honour payment. Mandatory compliance incident raised. MLRO notification.

nfrs.description: SVC-006 must fire an automated alert to Trade Finance Operations at T+4 banking days (1 banking day before deadline) and an escalation alert to Head of Trade Finance Operations at T+4.5 banking days (4 hours before deadline) if examination has not been completed.
nfrs.target: T+4 alert, T+4.5 escalation — automated via SVC-107

nfrs.description: For sight LCs with compliant documents, the settlement account debit (SVC-005 call) and SWIFT MT202 event (EVT-081) must be initiated within 1 business day of examination_result = compliant being recorded. SWIFT MT202 transmission by SVC-010 must occur within SWIFT same-day cut-off (typically 17:00 UK time).
nfrs.target: Settlement initiated within 1 business day of compliant examination result
nfrs.regulatory_basis: UCP 600 Article 15(a) — issuing bank must honour a complying presentation

nfrs.description: The SVC-005 account debit and SVC-010 SWIFT MT202 reimbursement must be treated as atomic from a business perspective. The SWIFT event (EVT-081) is only published after a successful debit confirmation from SVC-005. If the SVC-005 debit fails (insufficient funds, frozen account), no SWIFT event is published and the settlement is suspended for manual review.
nfrs.target: No EVT-081 published unless SVC-005 debit returns 200 OK

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All API endpoints under /trade-finance/ require Bearer JWT with scope commercial.trade-finance issued by SVC-100 (IAM). Settlement mutations (POST /debit, examination recording) require MFA re-authentication per PSR 2017 SCA. Role-based access: PER-002 can only read/submit own LCs; PER-059 can record examinations; PER-050 has customer-scoped RM access.
cross_cutting_nfrs.regulatory_basis: PSR 2017 SCA. GOV-005-R04 (SM&CR — authorised user accountability).

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All LC records (ENT-036–ENT-039), SWIFT message records, examination findings, compliance screening records, and settlement evidence must be retained for 7 years in the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111). Trade documents (bills of lading, invoices) in SVC-054 must be retained for 7 years. This supports FCA record-keeping obligations, UCP 600 dispute resolution (ICC Banking Commission arbitration has no fixed time limit), and OFSI audit.
cross_cutting_nfrs.regulatory_basis: FCA COBS record-keeping. MLR 2017 Regulation 40. OFSI audit requirements. UCP 600 / ICC dispute resolution evidence.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: Every status transition of LetterOfCredit (ENT-036), every DocumentExamination result (ENT-039), every EVT-076/EVT-077 compliance screening pair, and every settlement event (EVT-081) must produce a WORM audit record in SVC-111. Audit records must be queryable within 2 business days for regulatory production requests (FCA/OFSI data requests).
cross_cutting_nfrs.regulatory_basis: MLR 2017. OFSI sanctions compliance evidence. UCP 600 compliance evidence. FCA COBS regulatory record-keeping.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: SVC-006 (Trade Finance Service) must meet a 99.5% availability SLA (T3 tier per service-dependencies.json). The UCP 600 examination deadline enforcement scheduler must be a separately deployed, highly available component with its own health check. A scheduler failure that causes a missed examination deadline escalation constitutes a P1 incident.
cross_cutting_nfrs.regulatory_basis: UCP 600 Article 14(b) examination deadline is a hard legal obligation. FCA PS21/3 operational resilience — important business service.

cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All ENT-036–ENT-039 entity data and trade document storage in SVC-054 must remain in UK data residency. SWIFT message payloads transit the SWIFT network but originating data must remain UK-resident. Beneficiary name and address fields are PII and are subject to UK GDPR data minimisation in event payloads (event bus carries IDs only; full PII stays in SVC-006 PostgreSQL).
cross_cutting_nfrs.regulatory_basis: UK GDPR. SVC-006 data_residency: UK only per service-catalogue.json.

regulatory_slas.description: Maximum 5 banking days from date of presentation to examine documents and determine compliance
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: UCP 600 Article 16(f) — bank loses right to claim discrepancies; obliged to honour payment on discrepant documents

regulatory_slas.description: If refusing documents, a single notice must be given by end of the 5th banking day specifying all discrepancies and stating whether documents are held or returned
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Bank precluded from claiming the documents do not comply; bank must honour

regulatory_slas.description: All LC beneficiaries and relevant parties must be screened against OFSI consolidated list and OFAC SDN list before LC issuance. No LC may be issued without compliance clearance.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Criminal offence under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018. OFSI financial penalty (unlimited). Reputational damage. PRA/FCA enforcement.

regulatory_slas.regulation: UCP 600 Article 15(a) — Honour on Complying Presentation
regulatory_slas.description: On determination of a complying presentation, the issuing bank must honour — for sight LC: pay at sight; for deferred payment LC: incur deferred payment undertaking and pay at maturity
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Contractual breach of irrevocable payment undertaking. UCP 600 dispute. ICC Banking Commission arbitration. Reputational damage in international trade finance market.

regulatory_slas.regulation: Export Control Act 2002 / Export Control Order 2008 — Dual-Use Goods Screening
regulatory_slas.description: HS tariff codes must be screened against the UK Strategic Export Controls dual-use goods list before LC issuance for goods with potential military or WMD application
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Criminal offence under Export Control Act 2002 for knowingly financing controlled goods exports without appropriate licence. Unlimited fine.
